tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i mngon rtogs bzhugs so// bla ma dang yi dam lha tshogs dpal ldan lha mo nag po dur khrod kyi bdag mo chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' yis rjes su gnang ba mdzod cig bstan srung chen mo rdo rje rab brtan ma 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba dang / mchod gtor la sogs pa'i dus su 'khor dang bcas pa'i bskyed chog rgyas par byed par 'dod pas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar yaṃ las rlung nag dgu rlung 'khyil ba dang / raṃ las me dpung dmar nag 'bar ba'i dbus su/ baṃ las khrag gi rgya mtsho dmar zhing dwangs pa rba klong 'khrug pa'i klong dkyil du/ bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rmang gzhi lcags las byas pa/ logs bzhi gser las grub pa/ zur bzhi mchong las byas pa/ bai ḍūr+ya sngon po'i ba gam dang kha bad gser las byas pa/ dngul gyi them skas dang sgo glegs can shel gyi skas 'dzegs btsugs pa/ de'i nang du thod pa dgu brtsegs kyi mkhar dmar po sgo gcig pa/ mi ro rengs pa'i ka ba dang / 'greng bus kyi gdung dang / rtsibs rus kyi cham dang / ti ra'i gral khebs btang ba/ tsit+ta'i tog zhing chen gyi rgyal mtshan phyogs mtshams su btsugs pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla bre/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ don snying gi phyang 'phrul/ rus chen gyi drwa bas brgyan pa/ de'i phyi rol du lcags ri nag po gru bzhi pas bskor ba'i phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du rab tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis khor yug tu bskor ba/ thod skam gyi rwa ba'i nang du mi ro 'bum khrir brtsigs shing / rta ro 'bum gcal du bkram pa'i steng du/ rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs dang ldan pa'i srin po'i dre'u rta gwa dmar rlung ltar 'phyo ba/ srin po'i ya mgal gyis sga'i snga ru dang / ma mgal gyis phyi ru/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pas sga g.yogs pa/

dug sbrul nag pos gong smad srab mthur blo mnan byas pa/ de'i steng du yi ge kaṃ smug nag yongs su gyur pa las dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma sku mdog smug nag srin mo khros pa'i gzugs can/ mthong ba tsam gyis dgra bo'i srog 'phrog pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar bas dgra bgegs kyi srog gcod pa/ g.yon pas thod rlon khrag gis byur bur gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mchan khung na ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa'i kha nas nor bu rin po che'i char 'bebs pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol ba/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing / mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyug cing mi ro rengs pa za ba/ spyan gsum dmar zhing bzlog pas dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ khro gnyer rab tu bsdus shing zhal nas ha ha hi hi ru lu ru lu rak+mo ko ta sha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs pa/ ral pa dmar nag gyen du gzengs pas bar snang khebs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la seng ge dang / g.yon pa la dug sbrul gyi gdengs kas brgyan cing / snyan cha gser gyi dril bu dkrol ba/ phyag zhabs kyi sen mo rnams zangs kyi sder mo dmar zing nge ba/ ral pa dang ba spu'i gseb nas me stag dmar po 'tsheg cing 'thor ba/ sku stod la mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pa lding stabs su gsol ba/ sku smad la re lde'i sham thabs dkris pa/ sbrul nag khra dang / ser khras lus dang yan lag brgyan pa/ khrag zhag dang til mar gyi khu bas lus byugs pa/ zhabs gnyis lcags sgrog sngon pos dkris shing tshan 'khyil gyi stabs su bzhugs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa la brgyus pa'i do shal 'phyang ba/ spyi bo'i gtsug na zla ba rgyas shing / lte ba'i khung nas nyi ma 'char ba/ srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing dgra bo'i srog 'phrog pa'i rngams brjid drag shul dang ldan pa/

de'i mdun du khol mo nag mo bdud mo ri ma ti bud med dmar po lus skems shing bongs thung ba chu srin gyi mgo can zangs kyi ral pa dmar sha re ba thur du 'phyang ba/ mche ba dkar zhing gzengs pa dpag tshad stong du sleb pas gang dang 'phrad pa'i srog la rgol ba/ phyag na mtshon cha nyi khri bdun 'bum gyi rkyal pa thogs nas dgra yul du mtshon char 'bebs pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pa gos su gyon zhing / sbrul nag gi chun pos phyag zhabs brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshub ma zhon nas stong gsum skad cig nyid la nyul zhing chu srin mang po pho nyar 'gyed pa'o/ /g.yas su ming po klu chen thod dkar sku mdog dkar po khro 'dzum gyi bzhin can ral pa'i thor tshugs la dar dkar gyi cod paṇa 'phur ba/ phyag g.yas pas mda' dar dkar po g.yab cing / g.yon pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs dkar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po'i ral gu gsol ba/ klu rta dkar po la chibs pa/ g.yon du las mkhan klu bdud nag po khro zhing rngam la mi sdug pa/ ral pa nag po zing zhing sprug pa/ phyag g.yas lcags mdung ba dan nag po g.yo ba nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon dam nyams kyi klad khrag dang dgra snying gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ dar nag po'i 'jol ber gyon pa/ rta nag po rting dkar la zhon pa/ de dag gi phyi rol du/ shar du dkar mo zhal gyi pho nya mo/ mdog dkar mo zhi zhing 'dzum pa dung gi thor tshugs dang thod gdengs can/ phyag na ral gri dang thod pa thogs pa/ na bza' bya rgod dkar po'i thul ba gsol ba/ rang 'dra'i dkar mo bye ba 'bum gyis bskor ba/ lhor srin mo nag mo ral pa 'dzings pa/ khro zhing 'khrug pa'i nyams can g.yu'i thor tshugs pa dang thod gdengs can/ phyag na ral gri dang thod pa thogs pa/ sku la mi lpags kyi thul ba gsol ba/ rang 'dra ba'i nag mo bye ba 'bum gyis bskor ba/ nub tu dmar mo chen po gtum pa mo mdog dmar mo/

sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can/ byi ru dmar po'i thor tshugs dang thod gdengs can phyag na gri dang thod pa thogs pa/ sku la mi lpags kyi thul ba gsol ba/ rang 'dra ba'i dmar mo bye ba 'bum gyis bskor ba/ byang du ser mo rdo rje mkha' la bzhad pa mo mdog ser mo 'gying zhing brjid pa'i nyams can gser gyi thor tshugs dang thod gdengs can/ phyag na gri dang thod pa thogs pa/ mi lpags kyi thul ba gsol ba/ rang 'dra ba'i ser mo bye ba 'bum gyis bskor ba'o/ /de rnams kyi mdun phyogs su bka'i pho nya ba lang dre'u sna ma mdog nag mo khrag gi ral pa dmar nag mkha' la gzengs shing / gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i thod gdengs can/ phyag g.yas mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi rlon pa'i g.yab mo sdeb cing / g.yon pas skra dang bcas pa'i thod rlon khrag gis gang ba 'thung ba/ re lde nag po gos su gyon pa/ dre'u nag po kha dkar la chibs nas ma mo dang bdud kyi dmag sna 'dren pa/ de'i las byed sngon la rgyug pa'i ma ye shes nag mo gzig gi pags pa'i stod g.yogs gyon pa/ lag na thod pa khrag bkang thogs nas dgra bo'i yul du khrag nad kyi char 'bebs pa/ ba skya ru sngon la chibs pa/ rgyab phyogs su las kyi pho nya khri sman sa le ma nag mo khrag gi ral pa thur du 'phyang zhing / gser g.yu brtsegs pa'i thod gdengs can/ phyag g.yas chu srin rgyal mtshan nam mkhar sgreng zhing / g.yon pa thod rlon khrag gis gang ba thogs pa/ sku la mi lpags rlon pa gsol ba/ bso bya rog po la chibs nas lha mo'i phyi bzhin du 'brang ba/ de'i rjes 'brang ha la nag mo lag na thod pa khrag nad kyis gang ba thogs nas/ dgra bo'i grong mtha' bskor zhing dal yams 'bebs pa/ gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya seng ge dang / stag dang / dur bya dang / ce spyang la sogs pa'i bya gcan gdug pa can mang po 'phur zhing lding la rgyug cing 'dral bas/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag la rngams zhing rol ba/

bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ rang 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas snang srid kyi dregs byed lha srin sde brgyad/ sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad gang ba/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ ma mo thams cad kyi thugs ka'i stod du sa bon bh+yo yig re res mtshan par bsam/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ lha yul yongs 'du'i nags tshal/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang / byang shar mu le mthing mtsho/ mthing smug 'bar ba'i brag phug nub phyogs u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang / dkar chu rgya sde'i gnas mchog grom pa rgyang gi lha khang / rgyan gong byang chub dge gnas kyi gtsug lag khang / dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi chos grwa chen po/ gzhan yang yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad la sogs pa/ rang rang bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams nas dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ ming po las mkhan/ bka' nyan pho nya sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang dam tshig rjes su dran pas nam mkha' la sprin 'thibs pa'am/ bar snang la char 'bab pa'am/ sa gzhi la rlung nag 'tshub pa lta bur sgra dang bcas pas/ skad cig thang cig yud tsam la badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ bdag nyid la je nye je nye gad rgyangs drag po rgod cing ral pa sprug bzhin pas byon par bsam/ spyan 'dren/ mchod bstod/ gtor 'bul/ bzlas pa/ bskang bshags la sogs dkyus ltar bya'o/ /de nas dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab bstan ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i bskyed chog rgyas pa 'di ni/

ma mo spyi sgos kyi rgyud dang / slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ne'u rkyal ma dang / lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge dang gsung bsgros la brten nas gang zag las dang po ba spros pa la dga' ba'i rigs can rnams kyi don du/ dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi gdan sa bcu gsum pa/ shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sdes/ 'dar stod mang mkhar srin mo'i phrang rang byon don zhag lha lnga'i pho brang rang gi bsti gnas bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //dge'o// // ༄༅/ /dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gtor chog bsdus pa bzhugs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum/ mdun du trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su kam̐ kam̐ las lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas ral gri/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku stod la mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang / sku smad la re lde'i sham thabs gsol ba/ dre'u gwa pa la chibs par gyur/ de'i dpral bar om̐/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūm̐ gi steng du bh+yo smug nag rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ byang shar mtshams nas rdo rje rab brtan ma 'khor dang bcas pa om̐ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rak+mo du ra dun+ti bh+yo/ he ra du ra dun+ti bh+yo/ kha kha du ra dun+ti bh+yo/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.ar+ghaṃ/ pat+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhuṣ+pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ ne wi te/ shap+ta ā hūm̐/ t+yathā/ ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba to si/ ma mo rak+mo/ tsit+ta kha rak+mo bh+yo bh+yo swāhā/ ci nus bzlas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ om̐ bā liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ yo gi ni kha raṃ khā hi/ ḍā ki ni kha raṃ khā hi/ taṃ pa wak+ka tsit+ta a ka pa la hoḥ.om̐ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ/

a d+ya nut+pan+na tod ta oṃ ā hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ ā hūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ bh+yo/ lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /sku mdog smug nag chen mo la/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /sku la mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol/ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba bsnams/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis ne'u le 'dzin/ /chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs/ /'phrin las bcol ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /mtshan gsum glog ltar 'khyug cing byon/ /nyin gsum khra ltar nyul zhing byon/ /ma gcig rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi 'di bzhes shig /rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /bstan ma'i gtso mo rab brtan ma/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bstan pa gnyan po khyod kyis srungs/ /zhes brjod/ rjes kyi cho ga spyi dang mthun par bya'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i mngon rtogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
